body:
`flow._apply_recorded_decision` (template/src/pdca_harness/flow.py, around line 254 as of the pdca-pdca issue_453 review) announces that a recorded decision will be applied without a new session **before** the C6 accept-guard has run. When the recorded accept is then refused by C6 (open §6 NEEDS-HUMAN items), the operator reads "no new session" immediately followed by the refusal — the notice promised something the guard then withdrew.

Fix: move the notice after the C6 check, or reword it so it doesn't assert the outcome before the guard has decided.

Surfaced as a §10 Act candidate on pdca-pdca issue_453; routed upstream at the 2026-08-09 Act review (process/act-log.md).
title: flow: "no new session" notice prints before the C6 accept-guard runs — a C6-refused accept contradicts it one line later
